items.title: General School Build-Partner Proposal
items.body:
Dear [Name],

I run Joshua Creek Tennis, a private tennis club and academy in Oakville. Our academy is rated among the top in the country, and after 30 years in operation, we're exploring new ways to bring that program to more of the community.

I have an idea I'd like to bring to [School Name]. We would build and fully fund a seasonal dome sports facility on a portion of your property, at no cost to the school. We cover design, construction, insurance, and all ongoing operating costs. In exchange, we'd lease the land from you for a nominal amount, and your students and community would get exclusive or priority access to the facility.

This gives [School Name] a real athletic facility upgrade without any capital investment, and gives us the space to continue growing our academy. I'd welcome the chance to meet and walk through what this could look like for your campus.

Thank you for your time, I look forward to hearing from you.

Craig Young
Joshua Creek Tennis

items.title: Golf & Country Club Seasonal Dome Proposal
items.body:
Dear [Name],

I run Joshua Creek Tennis, a private tennis club and academy in Oakville. After 30 years running one of the top-rated academies in the country, I have been looking at ways to make better use of facilities that already exist but sit unused for part of the year.

I have an idea for [Club Name]. Your outdoor tennis courts likely sit empty all winter while your golf season is on pause. We would install a seasonal dome over your existing courts for the off-season, fully funded and operated by us, and run our tennis academy programming under it. Your club gets a real winter amenity and revenue from months that currently earn nothing, at no cost or effort on your end. We would work out a lease or revenue-share arrangement that makes sense for both sides.

Our season runs opposite yours, fall through spring, so there is no competition for the space, just two businesses sharing one footprint at different times of year.

I would welcome the chance to meet and walk through what this could look like for your club.

Thank you for your time, I look forward to hearing from you.

Craig Young
Joshua Creek Tennis
